name: Schweizer 300 / Hughes 269
summary: Light piston training helicopter with a three-blade rotor and strut-braced tail boom, long used for flight training, agriculture and police patrol.

engines: Piston engine mounted behind and below the seats, largely exposed
Exhaust and cooling ducts visible in the open engine bay
fuselage: Rounded goldfish-bowl bubble cabin for two or three seats
tail: Thin tubular tail boom braced by two diagonal struts from the fuselage
Small two-blade tail rotor with a small vertical and horizontal stabilizer

tellTales: Three-blade rotor on a tiny piston bubble helicopter
Thin tail boom held up by diagonal bracing struts
Exposed engine under and behind the bubble

confusedWith.howToTell: The R22 has a two-blade rotor and an unbraced boom; the 300 has three blades and a strut-braced boom.
The Bell 47 has an open lattice truss boom and two blades; the 300 has a tubular strut-braced boom and three blades.

usCount.source: FAA registry make/model inquiry (Hughes/Schweizer 269 and S-300 series)
